card.fires_on: The first letters of a word that is only partly spelled so far, such as F in FcRn or FOSAMAX, T in TID or TDF, and Hyp before -ot- or -ert- in hypotension or hypertonic. It fires in drug label text.

modes.label: Brand name capitals
modes.description: A single capital letter that begins an all-caps brand or abbreviation such as FOSAMAX, TID or TDF.

modes.label: Hypo/hyper terms
modes.description: The middle of hypotension or hypertension words, right after Hyp or hyper.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word continuations beginning with lo, ch or su, and away from du, Ph or k.
card.plain: It fires on the opening letters of a drug name or a hypo/hyper term that is still being spelled out.
